newsitem.title: CANADA: Norcen unit spinoff to net C$235 mln.
newsitem.headline: Norcen unit spinoff to net C$235 mln.

text.p: Norcen Energy Resources Ltd and the Superior Propane Income Fund said on Thursday that the fund had reached an underwriting deal to sell 22,848,695 units priced at C$10.95 each, for gross proceeds of about C$250 million.

Net proceeds, expected to total C$235 million, will be used by the Fund to buy indirectly from Norcen a 50 percent stake in Superior Propane Inc, with Norcen keeping the remaining 50 percent. Proceeds will be used over time in Norcen's oil and gas business.
The deal is expected to close on October 8.
The offering was managed by an underwriting group led by ScotiaMcleod Inc.
Superior Propane is Canada's largest retail marketer of propane and provides services to over 200,000 customers nationwide.

"We are pleased with the progress of this transaction and look forward to as successful closing. The proceeds with proved Norcen with the strong financial position to take advantage of various investment opportunities in our oil and gas business, Norcen president and chief executive officer Grant Billing said.
